title: display-name/v1
description: names/<pseudonym>.yaml at the graph root (F25-R6; D-3, D-19 v3.37): the display name, and optionally a link, a contributor chooses to be shown by where the network names its contributors outside itself — a registration's authors — in place of their pseudonym. Written only by the holder of the pseudonym, through the service, and signed by the approval key; the gate refuses any other writer. The latest record wins; a record whose `name` is null withdraws the name. Nothing on the site reads it in this version. A one-way publication of a name, which is why withdrawal exists from the first version. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

pseudonym.description: the ledger identity the name is for; the file is named after it

name.description: the display name; null withdraws an earlier one

link.description: an ORCID record or an institutional page, optional; rendered only through an allowlist built from validated records (F11-Q11)

via.description: how the signature was made: `approval-key`, by the network's approval key through the service for the bearer of the pseudonym's token; `ssh`, by the holder's own key, for a hand-opened pull request from the GitHub login the pseudonym is paired with

key.description: the key the signature verifies under

signature.description: an OpenSSH SSHSIG armored signature over the record's canonical body (opn_gate.signed)
